name: SambaFlow (SambaNova RDU runtime)
design_goal: compile-once dataflow graphs onto Reconfigurable Dataflow Units (RDU); whole-model residency across a node
vendor runtime for SN40L/SN30 accelerators, not a general-purpose engine
notable_features: static dataflow compilation; model is laid out across RDU tiles at compile time
batch size and sequence length pinned per compiled graph
hardware_caveats: runs ONLY on SambaNova DataScale nodes (SN40L RDU); not portable
long compile times; one graph per (model, batch, seqlen) triple
best_for: vendor-benchmark rows where SambaNova publishes aggregate tok/s through its own stack
avoid_for: any cross-engine comparison that expects per-request decode parity with vLLM/llama.cpp
notes: Added 2026-10-14 to give benchmark.engine_id a real record for the Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench SN40L rows (arXiv:2411.00136). SambaFlow is SambaNova's closed-source compiler+runtime stack; the Argonne measurements use it because SN40L has no PyTorch-eager path for LLMs.
